title: Frontend Architecture
desc: How the React app is organized.
lede: The UI is a React app with a clear split between canonical data and live overlays.
body:
At a glance
  • pages / components / hooks / store / theme.
  • Canonical data vs live overlays.
  • Tests under frontend/tests.

Organization

The app is organized into pages, components, hooks, a store, and theme. The store holds UI state; it is not a second source of truth for canonical data.

Canonical vs live

Canonical data comes from the backend; live overlays show in-flight progress. Keeping them distinct avoids the frontend drifting from server truth. Tests live under frontend/tests.
